[SCSI] bfa: ioc attributes fix

This patch fixes the APIs to obtain ioc attributes
- fix API to obtain wwpn, wwnn, and mac.
- add API to get mfg wwpn, wwnn, and mac.
- fix API to obtain wwn of boot target.
